$comment: Extension point: this meta-schema intentionally does not set additionalProperties:false on the object it describes, because it validates other normative JSON Schema documents, which legitimately carry arbitrary JSON Schema keywords beyond the four required contract-metadata fields.
title: Required contract schema metadata
description: Every normative JSON Schema document under contracts/ MUST satisfy this shape (Build and Contract Representation Closure, 10.2.2).

additionalProperties.description: Present and false on every normative schema unless an extension point is explicitly documented via $comment.
